title: CLAWBACK fails with CLAWBACK_NOT_CLAWBACK_ENABLED
pattern: A transaction whose CLAWBACK operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (not_clawback_enabled). The issuer never enabled clawback, so its trustlines carry no clawback flag.

hazards.placement: clawback from a trustline without the clawback flag

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
